message.content: {"caption":"An archive of evolving coding agents alongside their SWE-bench progress over iterations.","description":"Two-panel research figure. The left panel is a branching archive tree: colored node fills indicate SWE-bench scores, border colors distinguish task-evaluation counts, and edges show agent modifications; a star marks the final best agent. The right panel plots SWE-bench score against iterations for the archive average, best agent, and lineage leading to the final best agent. The average rises gradually, while the best-agent score improves in steps and the lineage includes temporary dips. Callouts identify tool and workflow changes, including finer-grained file editing, patch validation and retries, context summarization, multiple patch generation and ranking, and history-aware patch
